scope_summary: All 218 pages inspected at contact-sheet overview; eighteen selected full-page images inspected at 150 dpi. Supplement samples cover newly relocated S1-S6, a stopped-law proof, the opening, late technical material, and final references. Companion samples cover opening, theorem/equation pages, dependency layout and final references.
observations: No gross clipping, overlap, missing-page anomaly or inconsistent margins observed on the overview sheets.
Selected full-page text, mathematical glyphs, table alignment, equation numbers, headers, footers and references were legible with no observed collision or truncation.
Final references pages are partially filled as expected; unused contact-sheet cells are not PDF blank pages.
limits: No whole-document microscopic or line-by-line typography review is claimed.
No mathematical correctness, citation-priority, formal-proof, human-expert or editorial validation is supplied by this visual receipt.
The receipt applies only to the exact pinned draft02 PDF bytes. Final PDFs require exact equality or recorded comparison to these rendered pages.
A successful draft render is not a strict committed-source build or hosted CI result.

retry: Supplement initial batch stopped with SIGSEGV while shared disk exhaustion was observed. After root recovered storage, complete prior PNGs were retained, one incomplete generated PNG was removed, and missing ranges rendered in at most twelve-page subprocesses. All 181 page PNGs subsequently decoded successfully. No input PDF/source file was modified.
